name: application-breadcrumb-segmented-path
title: Breadcrumb Segmented Path
description: Pill-style segmented breadcrumb path with a home icon in place of a text root, plus a truncation variant that collapses middle segments into an ellipsis pill opening a dropdown menu.
useWhen: Showing the current location in a nested hierarchy with a distinct, chip-like visual treatment rather than plain text links.
The path is deep enough that middle segments should collapse into a truncation menu to keep the breadcrumb on one line.
A home icon is preferred over a text root segment such as "Home" or "Dashboard".
avoidWhen: A plain, low-emphasis text breadcrumb with simple dividers is more appropriate — use application-breadcrumbs instead.
The path never grows beyond 2-3 segments — the truncation variant adds unneeded complexity.
The current page's route also needs an inline action bar (search, share, more menu) — use application-breadcrumb-page-header or application-command-bar-breadcrumb instead.
responsiveBehavior: Segments wrap onto multiple lines on narrow viewports via flex-wrap; the truncation variant's dropdown is positioned absolutely below the ellipsis pill and does not affect the breadcrumb's own line height.
accessibility: The breadcrumb list is wrapped in a <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> landmark distinguishing it from other navigation.
The home pill's icon has an sr-only 'Home' label since the icon alone conveys no accessible name.
The current page segment uses aria-current="page" instead of being a clickable link.
The truncation menu uses a native <details>/<summary> disclosure, which is keyboard-operable and announced correctly by screen readers without additional script.

variants.title: Segmented path
variants.description: Short pill-style breadcrumb path with a home icon and a highlighted current page pill.
accessibility: Current page pill uses aria-current="page" rather than an interactive link.

variants.title: Segmented path (Dark)
variants.description: Segmented breadcrumb path adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Pill and current-page contrast meet WCAG AA against the dark page background.

variants.title: Truncated with menu
variants.description: Segmented path with middle segments collapsed into an ellipsis pill that opens a dropdown of hidden segments.
accessibility: The ellipsis pill has an sr-only label describing its function; the disclosure is native <details>/<summary>, keyboard-operable by default.

variants.title: Truncated with menu (Dark)
variants.description: Truncated segmented breadcrumb path adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Dropdown menu contrast and focus outline remain visible against the dark background.
